Primary goals: predictable p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and robust rollback/fallback behavior for regional outages.

meeting_notes: Customer: product + infra leads (CTO + platform lead)
They liked hosted API latency but want isolation and predictable throughput for peak events
Asked for canary strategy, automatic fallback to hosted region, and a clear rollback window
Quote from CTO: 'We cannot afford 5m blips during peak feature launches'
poc_plan: Environment: Dedicated GPU pool in us-west and eu-west replica
Access: VPC peering + SSO test accounts; KMS test key loaded
Milestones: Week1 infra + smoke tests, Week2 baseline perf, Week3 canary, Week4 ramp + decision
poc_success_criteria: Latency SLO: p95 < 200ms for chat path (512-token window)
Throughput: sustained 200 QPS with <1% tail error
Cost: unit token cost within 15% of projected estimate in pricing deck
Reliability: automated fallback triggers exercise successfully in 2 test scenarios
canary_plan: Canary percent: start at 5% of production traffic -> 20% -> 100% (if green)
Duration per step: 30m steady window with metric checks
Metrics to watch: p95 latency, error rate, token/sec, retry rate, model quality regressions
Kill/rollback criteria: p95 > 300ms OR error rate >2% for 5m -> immediate rollback
Operator actions: automatic rollback + route remaining traffic to hosted API region on trigger
fallback_routing_plan: Primary: route to Dedicated us-west pool running model variant rwd-70b-q4
Fallback1: auto-route to hosted API in us-east (same model family), if Dedicated pool unhealthy
Fallback2: degrade to smaller model variant (rwd-13b-quant) for non-critical paths to preserve availability
Regional failover: if entire region down, route to eu-west Dedicated replica (with cache warmup policy)
Cache strategy: prefix/KV cache retention to accelerate warm starts during failover
technical_requirements: SSO via SAML (Okta) + SCIM for user provisioning
KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for model logs
Audit logs retention 1 year, exportable to SIEM
EU data residency for a subset of customer content
Ability to pin model versions and force rollbacks via API
pricing_notes: Interested in reserved capacity pricing for burst windows (monthly commit + burst overage)
Asked for blended ARR estimate to compare against self-hosting in GCP
Pricing sensitivity: medium — will pay premium for predictable latency and SLA
qa_notes: Will run evals on a 5k prompt testset provided by product team
Quality regression alert must be tied to prompt set; require auto-email to eng when drop >3 BLEU-equivalent metric
support_plan: Priority support during POC (SE on-call) - 6am-6pm PT
sales_notes: Champion: Head of Product (Maria G.) - strong influence on purchase
